provenance.how_produced: scripts/probe_determinism.py, run on the evaluation host against the live router. Values transcribed from the run output rather than written by the script to a file; the script now writes this file directly so a re-run overwrites it.
provenance.caveat: These are the only numbers in the paper that were not emitted into a data file by the analysis pipeline at the time of measurement. They are reported here so every figure quoted in the paper has a traceable home.
provenance.prompt: You are a phone GUI agent. Describe, step by step, how to turn on aeroplane mode from the Android home screen, then output a single action line. Think carefully before answering.
provenance.note: allow_fallbacks=false and an explicit provider+quantization pin on every request; the served provider was read back off each response.

runs.note: two of the three completions were byte-identical; on 2026-08-25 no two of three were

findings.determinism: Neither endpoint returned three identical completions on any day, at temperature 0 with a fixed seed, though both advertise seed support.
findings.endpoint_change: Between 2026-08-25 and 2026-08-26 the atlas-cloud/int4 endpoint produced shorter and less varied completions (mean 1937 -> 1309 tokens) while deepinfra/fp4, used as a control, did not shift comparably.
findings.trivial_prompt_trap: An earlier check with the prompt 'Reply with exactly: OK' returned byte-identical output twice on atlas-cloud/int4 and was recorded as evidence of determinism. That completion was 33 tokens.
